entry.title: dotnet/roslyn - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-12-16
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Hot Reload: Enable project level analysis #81728
  • C# can't combine ref and out parameters on the same method #81727
  • Displaying the list of incorrect attributes #81720
  • "Ignore space in declaration statements" does not ignore TABs #81718
    Backlog
  • rename crash in Vertical document group #81716
  • After Git switches branches, the project's Roslyn cache / project system cache does not flush correctly #81713
  • Editor frequently switches from tabs to spaces, despite prior style and .editorconfig setting #81712
  • Change method signature functionality behaves incorrectly when changing signature of methods with explicit implementations. #81711
  • FindAllReferences does not track extension members in CREF #81710
  • Failing assert in WasPropertyBackingFieldAccessChecked #81709
    18.3
  • bug: roslyn attempting to register file watcher for non-existent path #81708
  • Bug in state machines generated for IAsyncEnumerables - enumerators recycled too early #81707
    18.3

Closed

  • CS1525 raised on unexpected location #58298
    Backlog
  • CS1525 "Invalid expression term '/'" at wrong line when there is other comments prior to it #31774
    Backlog
  • IDE0059 message is not correct for C#14 extension method #81554
  • CSharpConvertIfToSwitchCodeRefactoringProvider crashes for if statement using nullable bool #81714
  • SyntaxKind is missing NIntKeyword and NUIntKeyword #81681
  • Nullable assert firing while building our Visual Studio code #67153
    18.3
  • [Broken Build]: Nullability issue with extension blocks #81699
  • [Automated] PRs inserted in VS build main-11315.51 #81703

PullRequests

Created

  • Hot Reload: Temporarily disable project-level analysis #81729
  • Relax a couple of asserts #81726
    Area-Compilers
  • Extensions: fix GetSymbolInfo within ExtensionMemberCrefSyntax #81722
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Extension Everything, VSCode
  • Initial support for nullable analysis for Unions #81721
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Unions
  • Fix crash in Rename adornment with vertical document groups #81717
    Area-IDE
  • Restore parsing from old branch #81705
    Needs API Review

Merged

  • Extensions: FindReferences should link extension members and implementations #81685
    Area-IDE, Feature - Extension Everything, VSCode, Next
  • Improve location of error diagnostic when encountering errant operator token #81295
    Area-Compilers, Next
  • Allow Razor to respond to renames #81725
    Area-IDE, Next
  • Don't report assignment to ref extension parameter as unused #81680
    Area-IDE, Feature - Extension Everything, VSCode, Next
  • Fix crash in convert-if-to-switch #81724
    Area-IDE, VSCode, Next
  • Simplify try/catch #81719
    Area-Infrastructure, VSCode, Next
  • Merge vs-extension-testing into Roslyn #81565
    Area-Infrastructure, Next
  • Revert unintentionally commented code #81715
    Area-Compilers, Next

Updated

  • Unsafe evolution: implement compat mode #81701
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Unsafe Evolution
  • Add SDK analyzer assembly redirector #80969
    Area-IDE
  • DeclarationTable allocation reductions #81627
    Area-Compilers
  • Add separate error for disallowed members in global namespace #81221
    Area-Compilers, Community, Needs UX Triage, VSCode
  • Improve error recovery around 'scoped' modifier parsing #81636
    Area-Compilers
  • Unsafe evolution: check lang version for caller-unsafe declarations #81698
    Area-Compilers, Feature - Unsafe Evolution
  • [main] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #81678
    Area-Infrastructure
  • Use ArrayExpansion for fixed buffer fields #81536
    Area-Compilers, Community
